name: s3-high-volume-deflector
description: Proactively diagnoses the highest-volume Amazon S3 failure modes - 403 access-denied across bucket policy, IAM, Block Public Access, VPC endpoint policy, KMS, and Object Ownership or ACL; replication stalls; lifecycle rule conflicts; and 503 SlowDown request-rate throttling from prefix fan-out - and produces a triage decision tree per failure class with self-service resolution guidance. Read-only and recommend-only. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 05:30 UTC
